UPDATE executions
            SET status = 'failed',
                attempts = attempts + 1,
                error = 'lease_lost',
                worker_id = NULL,
                lease_expires_at = NULL,
                completed_at = now()
          WHERE status = 'executing'
            AND request IS NOT NULL
            AND triggered_by IS DISTINCT FROM 'hybrid'
            AND lease_expires_at < now()
            AND attempts + 1 >= $1
